description: Systematic index of 15 material-driven, physically grounded design styles.

styles.name: Zurich Concrete Modernism
styles.subtitle: Swiss International Typographic Style
styles.lineage: Josef Müller-Brockmann (Musica Viva 1958, Beethoven 1955), Max Bill, Wim Crouwel, 1950s Kunsthalle posters
styles.philosophy: Mathematical acoustic rhythm, concentric harmonic curves, unadorned asymmetric grid, content as structure.

styles.name: 1960s Pop Art Serigraphy
styles.subtitle: Push Pin & Squeegee Screenprint
styles.lineage: Sister Corita Kent (Immaculate Heart College 1962–1968), Milton Glaser & Seymour Chwast (Push Pin Studios, Baby Teeth 1968, Dylan poster), Andy Warhol (The Factory screenprints)
styles.philosophy: Saturated flat silkscreen pigments, high-energy pop collisions, coarse 45-degree Ben-Day screen dot fields, bold expressive display lettering, squeegee registration pull drift.

styles.name: Tokyo Riso Lab
styles.subtitle: Fluorescent Multichrome Overprint
styles.lineage: Japanese independent zine press, Geidai printmaking lab, contemporary risograph workshops
styles.philosophy: Semi-transparent liquid soy inks, physical optical multiply overprints, vibrant fluorescent collisions.

styles.name: Constructivist Agit-Prop
styles.subtitle: The Dynamic Red Wedge & Shattered Target
styles.lineage: El Lissitzky (Beat the Whites with the Red Wedge 1919), Alexander Rodchenko, Varvara Stepanova
styles.philosophy: High-contrast dynamic thrust, fractured circular targets, splintering vector shards, interlocking text barricades.

styles.name: Dutch Matrix Modernism
styles.subtitle: Wim Crouwel / Total Design System
styles.lineage: Wim Crouwel, Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam (1963–1985), Vormgevers, New Alphabet 1967, Jurriaan Schrofer
styles.philosophy: Uncompromising isometric matrix grids, stepped diagonal construction, constructed letterforms as architectural volume.

styles.name: Low-Fi Thermal Fax & Teletext
styles.subtitle: 1-Bit Subculture Terminal
styles.lineage: 1980s fax net-art, point-of-sale thermal printers, BBS ANSI/ASCII teletext zines
styles.philosophy: Strict binary black/white physics, algorithmic pixel error-diffusion, transient communication aesthetic.

styles.name: Victorian Chromolitho Naturalist
styles.subtitle: The Linnaean Specimen
styles.lineage: Ernst Haeckel (Kunstformen der Natur), John James Audubon, 19th-century botanical copperplates
styles.philosophy: Meticulous anatomical observation, crosshatch copper intaglio, central isolation within embossed plate mark.

styles.name: 1977 Punk Zine & Xerography
styles.subtitle: Dadaist Ransom Counter-Press
styles.lineage: Sniffin' Glue, Jamie Reid (Sex Pistols), 1970s London/NY underground music fanzines
styles.philosophy: Democratized low-cost counter-culture, high-contrast electrostatic copier breakdown, aggressive pasted collage.

styles.name: De Stijl Neoplasticism
styles.subtitle: Gerrit Rietveld Chair & Orthogonal Grid
styles.lineage: Gerrit Thomas Rietveld (Rood-blauwe stoel 1918, Schröder House 1924), Theo van Doesburg (De Stijl journal, Leiden 1917–1931), Piet Mondrian
styles.philosophy: Strict primary neoplasticism, axonometric spatial projection of the Rietveld chair, yellow-capped structural timber joints, floating asymmetric Cartesian grid planes, modular block sans.

styles.name: Braun / Bauhaus Industrial Patent
styles.subtitle: The Functional Specification System
styles.lineage: Dieter Rams / Otl Aicher design guidelines, German DIN patent blueprints, Ulm School of Design
styles.philosophy: Utilitarian precision, axonometric projection, disciplined line weight hierarchy, explanatory clarity.

styles.name: Japanese Sōsaku-Hanga Woodcut
styles.subtitle: Shikō Munakata & Creative Print Movement
styles.lineage: Shikō Munakata (1903–1975, Buddhist print cycles), Kōshirō Onchi, Un'ichi Hiratsuka, Sōsaku-Hanga creative print movement (1918–1955)
styles.philosophy: Self-carved, self-printed artist expression, raw baren relief pressure rubbing, fibrous mulberry kozo washi, sumi carbon ink and cinnabar vermilion hanko stamps.

styles.name: 1980s Swiss Cyber New Wave
styles.subtitle: Wolfgang Weingart & April Greiman Hybrid Typography
styles.lineage: Wolfgang Weingart (Basel Kunstgewerbeschule), April Greiman (Does It Make Sense? 1986, CalArts, early Mac 128k bitmapped typography)
styles.philosophy: High-gloss Kromekote substrate, offset CMYK multi-angle halftone rosettes, CRT scanlines with chromatic aberration jitter, 72-dpi bitmapped type colliding with wide-spaced Swiss letterforms.

styles.name: 1950s Blue Note Hard Bop
styles.subtitle: Reid Miles & Francis Wolff Jazz Covers
styles.lineage: Reid Miles (Art Director, Blue Note Records 1956–1967), Francis Wolff (photography), Alfred Lion
styles.philosophy: Severe asymmetric crop of high-contrast musician silhouette, 45-degree photographic halftone grain, massive Franklin Gothic uppercase scale jump, saturated single-color header bar and catalog session numbers.

styles.name: Bauhaus Photogram & Typofoto
styles.subtitle: László Moholy-Nagy & Herbert Bayer 1925
styles.lineage: László Moholy-Nagy (Painting, Photography, Film 1925, rayograms), Herbert Bayer (Universal Type, Dessau Bauhaus 1925–1928)
styles.philosophy: Direct light photogram exposure on silver gelatin paper without a camera, optical lens luminescence and refraction shadows, stark lowercase Bayer sans, primary Bauhaus red directional force lines.

styles.name: 1970s Polish Poster School Surrealism
styles.subtitle: Jan Lenica & Henryk Tomaszewski Theatrical Metaphor
styles.lineage: Jan Lenica (Wozzeck 1964, Alban Berg), Henryk Tomaszewski, Franciszek Starowieyski, Polish Poster School (1955–1980)
styles.philosophy: Expressive biological metaphor, concentric organic contour rings in Poison Olive and Crimson Rust, hand-drawn painterly brush lettering, raw gouache textures with slight paper bleed.
